calibration_sources: cAST (Chunking via Abstract Syntax Trees for Code Retrieval) & Sourcegraph SCIP / LSIF Symbol Graph Specifications
Aider Repository Map (Tree-sitter Tags + Personalized PageRank Graph Ranking) & Cursor Merkle-Tree Sync Architecture
LocAgent / Agentless Graph-Guided Code Localization on SWE-Bench Verified

workload.repository_scale: 10-Million-LOC Enterprise Polyglot Monorepo (50,000 files, 180M tokens, 500 commits/hr)
workload.task_benchmark: 1,000 Multi-File Bug-Fix & Feature Tasks (SWE-Bench Verified / Enterprise Monorepo Equivalent)
workload.key_requirement: Locate cross-file definitions, type hierarchies, and 2-hop callers without exploding agent token budgets

tiers.name: Tier 1: 固定行数切块向量检索 (50行硬切 -> 劈裂函数体 + 丢失跨文件调用链)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive Fixed-Line Sliding-Window Vector RAG (Splits AST Nodes & Misses Imports)
tiers.indexing_and_retrieval_stack: 50-line sliding text chunks + standard prose embedding Top-10
tiers.structural_dependency_awareness: Zero AST boundary awareness; zero cross-file caller/callee or type-definition graph
tiers.recommended_for: Single-file snippet autocomplete only; fails on multi-file refactoring due to 34% hallucinated signatures.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 无索引纯 Agentic Ripgrep/Bash 暴搜循环 (26轮盲目试错 -> 狂烧 148K Tokens)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Index-Free Pure Agentic Ripgrep/Bash Loop (26-Turn Exploration -> 148K Tokens)
tiers.indexing_and_retrieval_stack: No pre-built index; agent iteratively runs grep, find, and view across 26 turns
tiers.structural_dependency_awareness: Finds exact string matches, but wastes 80% of turns reading dead-end files in a 10M-LOC repo
tiers.recommended_for: Tiny <500-file repositories or ad-hoc CLI scripts where building an index is unnecessary.

tiers.name: Tier 3: Tree-sitter AST 语法树切块 (注入父作用域头) + 混合精排 + Merkle 增量同步
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Tree-sitter AST Chunking (Scope Headers) + Hybrid BM25/Dense + Merkle Sync
tiers.indexing_and_retrieval_stack: Tree-sitter cAST boundary chunking + class/import header injection + Merkle hash incremental sync
tiers.structural_dependency_awareness: Preserves complete functions/classes, but lacks explicit 2-hop cross-file call/type graph edges
tiers.recommended_for: Fast IDE semantic code search and Q&A across medium-to-large repositories.

tiers.name: Tier 4: SCIP/LSIF 编译器级符号调用图谱 + PageRank RepoMap + 2跳 AST 定位 (Cursor/Aider 范式)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: SCIP/LSIF Compiler Symbol Graph + PageRank RepoMap + 2-Hop AST Agent
tiers.indexing_and_retrieval_stack: Tree-sitter Merkle AST + SCIP/LSIF cross-file symbol graph (Def/Ref/Impl) + Personalized PageRank RepoMap
tiers.structural_dependency_awareness: Automatically expands 1-hop callers & downstream type definitions in 3 turns (7.7x fewer tokens than grep)
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise 1M–50M LOC monorepo coding agents & automated PR/bug resolution requiring >94% cross-file recall.
